title: Haunted Lynchburg – Ghost hunt Nov. 27
excerpt: Haunted Rooms America is offering a chance to experience the paranormal with a chartered ghost hunt at two of the most haunted sites in Lynchburg.
content:
Haunted Rooms America is offering a chance to experience the paranormal with a chartered ghost hunt at two of the most haunted sites in Lynchburg.

The event will be held Nov. 27 and led by Haunted Rooms America. Cost is $129 per person and involves a six-hour adventure which will include the Lynchburg Jail and Old Lynchburg Funeral Home. All persons must be 18 or over but 16-17 can come with a responsible adult.

Built in 1893 just off the Lynchburg courthouse square, the Old Moore County Jail held prisoners and housed the sheriff’s family under the same roof for almost a century until it closed in 1990. Directly across the street stands the Old Lynchburg Funeral Home, where generations of the town’s dead were prepared for burial. Paranormal investigators report voices, movement in empty rooms and apparitions in both buildings.

The public is invited to join Haunted Rooms America for a six-hour after-hours investigation, with small groups rotating between the jail and the funeral home and professional ghost hunting equipment provided. The funeral home has no heating, so guests should dress warmly. Tickets are limited. The event will run from 8 p.m. to 2 p.m.

Guest will get exclusive after-hours access to both the Old Moore County Jail and the Old Lynchburg Funeral Home, a structured investigation sessions led by experienced Haunted Rooms America investigators, rotating between both buildings, use of professional ghost hunting equipment, including EMF detectors, trigger objects, thermal imaging devices and motion sensors, plus EVP sessions run by their team, free time to investigate independently, Optional Estes Method sessions run by their team during free roam. Snacks and refreshments are provided.

Equipment and recording: Guests are welcome to bring their own ghost hunting equipment (EMF meters, spirit boxes, REM pods and similar). For the privacy of other guests and venue security, photography, video and audio recording are not permitted at any point during the event.
